claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SCH-28080 is a K+-competitive gastric H+,K+-ATPase inhibitor that does not affect tumor cell pHi or viability at micromolar concentrations, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
